purpose: M5 WP5.2 preregistered v2 protocol: the complete nested evaluation protocol, candidate list, calibration policy and numerical gates committed before any v2 experiment runs. The M7 release decision is a mechanical application of these gates, not reviewer judgment.

fold_rules.single_primitive_rule: M6 and M7 must consume one shared target-free fold primitive driven only by this config; reimplementing fold logic outside it is prohibited.

inner.semantics: deterministic match-grouped folds; not temporal; not forward-chaining; chronology is claimed only between outer LOTO scopes through tournament identity, never within development

tie_behavior.rule: unresolved selection ties resolve mechanically to the simpler candidate, mirroring the post-M4 roadmap's final-refit tie rule

calibration_intercept_slope.method: logistic regression of the observed outcome on the logit of the predicted probability, intercept and slope fitted jointly by maximum likelihood

metrics.reliability_diagrams: descriptive evidence only, never an optimization target

allowed.name: constant_prevalence
allowed.definition: training-fold non-penalty goal prevalence; no features, no fitting beyond the fold base rate

allowed.name: v1_form_l2_logistic
allowed.definition: the v1 geometry and categorical representation rebuilt under the corrected fold-local pipeline, with L2-penalized logistic regression (sklearn LogisticRegression, penalty l2)

allowed.name: context_rich_spline_logistic
allowed.definition: the M6 feature bundle selected inside each outer training partition by the frozen M6 bundle evaluator, with fold-fitted spline bases and L2-penalized logistic regression (sklearn LogisticRegression, penalty l2)

allowed.name: hist_gradient_boosting_challenger
allowed.definition: exactly one sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier challenger consuming the same inner-selected raw information as the context-rich spline logistic

bundle_evaluator.scope: frozen in M6; applied inside each outer training partition using only that partition's match-grouped inner validation predictions; never applied globally against held-out tournament outcomes

admission.log_loss_requirement: mean log-loss improvement whose 95% match-bootstrap confidence interval lies wholly below zero

internal_replacement.scope: pooled outer leave-one-tournament-out predictions, decided before any sealed set is opened
internal_replacement.ci_requirement: 95% paired match-bootstrap confidence interval for the log-loss difference wholly below zero

adoption.ci_requirement: 95% paired match-bootstrap confidence interval for the log-loss difference wholly below zero

external_qualification.comparator: stronger of v1 raw and v1 calibrated on the combined external set

promotion_gate.ci_requirement: 95% paired match-bootstrap confidence interval for the log-loss difference wholly below zero

external_qualification.on_failure: retain v1 in production and publish v2 as a negative result

stop_conditions.on_external_gate_failure: retain v1, publish v2 as a negative result, stop model selection until a newly pinned, genuinely untouched complete tournament exists

evidence_hierarchy.outer_loto_results: internal development/selection evidence; produced by the procedure that selected bundles, hyperparameters and the final refit; optimistically biased; never presented as the unbiased post-selection estimate of v2 quality
evidence_hierarchy.sealed_external_qualification: the external generalization evidence; the only basis for the v1-versus-v2 replacement decision

rules: No model may consume a sealed set's rows or labels before the frozen M7 candidate exists; opening a set happens exactly once for its qualification run.
Every learned preprocessing step (vocabulary construction, rare-level merging, missingness policy, scaling, spline knots, encodings) is fitted inside the relevant training partition only.
One versioned transformer powers training, batch prediction and API prediction; duplicated feature logic is prohibited.
Provider xG, shot outcome, post-shot and identity features (player, team, competition, coach) are excluded from the feature set.
The holdout principle carries over: selection never uses rows whose only permitted use is reporting.
Adding candidate families or widening search spaces after any v2 run has executed requires a new ADR and invalidates preregistration claims.
